newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON BEATS FREE STATE 59-30.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON BEATS FREE STATE 59-30.

text.p: The Wellington Hurricanes beat Orange Free State 59-30 (halftime 30-23)in a Super 12 match on Sunday.
Wellington Hurricanes: Tries: Christian Cullen (3), Jason O'Halloran, Tana Umaga, Mark Cooksley, Alex Telea, penalty try; Penalties: Jon Preston (3); Conversions: Preston (4), Jarrod Cunningham.
Free State: Tries: Os du Randt, Charl van Rensburg, Stephen Brink; Penalties: Jannie de Beer (3); Conversions: de Beer (3).
